const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE, MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w36-20260926'
name = 'tome-cults.lua'
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
before = loader.load_path(task / 'baseline' / name, logical_path=name).records
after = loader.load_path(root / name, logical_path=name).records
assert len(before) == len(after) == 2199, (len(before), len(after))
work = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
assert len(work) == 21
allowed = {(x['section'], x['source'], x['source_tag']): x for x in work}
assert len(allowed) == 21
frozen = json.loads((task / 'BASELINE-records.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))[name]
base_by_key = {(x.get('section'),x.get('source'),x.get('source_tag')): x for x in before if x.get('kind') == 'translation'}
for x in frozen:
    assert base_by_key[(x['section'],x['source'],x['source_tag'])] == x
placeholder = re.compile(r'%[-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]')
def no_line(x): return {k:v for k,v in x.items() if k != 'line'}
def leading_tabs(s): return [len(line)-len(line.lstrip('\t')) for line in s.split('\n')]
def blank_indices(s): return [i for i,line in enumerate(s.split('\n')) if line == '']
def trailing_ws(s): return [i for i,line in enumerate(s.split('\n')) if line.rstrip(' \t') != line]
changed=[]
for old,new in zip(before,after):
    left,right=no_line(old),no_line(new)
    if left == right: continue
    key=(old.get('section'),old.get('source'),old.get('source_tag'))
    assert key in allowed, ('out_of_scope', key)
    item=allowed[key]
    assert old['target'] == item['target_preimage']
    assert {k:v for k,v in left.items() if k != 'target'} == {k:v for k,v in right.items() if k != 'target'}
    source,target=new['source'],new['target']
    assert source.count('\n') == target.count('\n'), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert leading_tabs(source) == leading_tabs(target), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert blank_indices(source) == blank_indices(target), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert trailing_ws(target) == [], item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(source) == MARKUP_RE.findall(target), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(source) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(target), item['entry_revision_identity']
    assert placeholder.findall(source) == placeholder.findall(target), item['entry_revision_identity']
    changed.append(item['entry_revision_identity'])
assert len(changed) == 21, len(changed)
assert set(changed) == {x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in work}
data=(root/name).read_bytes()
assert b'\r' not in data and data.endswith(b'\n')
target_revision='e487193fbfa5a2ec578a935ffafb390d6425c1737a9d3457ac51f749151cddbd'
item=next(x for x in work if x['entry_revision_identity']==target_revision)
key=(item['section'],item['source'],item['source_tag'])
current=next(x for x in after if (x.get('section'),x.get('source'),x.get('source_tag'))==key)['target']
assert current.count('岩谷') == 3
assert '当我们走近岩谷时' in current
assert '微弱的阳光射入了岩谷' in current
assert '直接冲进岩谷' in current
assert '当我们走近岩壁时' not in current
assert '微弱的阳光射入了岩壁' not in current
assert '冲进岩壁' not in current
print(json.dumps({'verified':True,'runtime':'manifest-compatible LuaJIT / Lua 5.1','records_compared':len(after),'changed_targets':len(changed),'non_target_changes':0,'line_tab_blank_markup_invariants':'21/21','fixed_revision':target_revision,'fixed_substitutions':3,'pure_lf':True,'final_lf':True},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict
git diff --check","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我运行任务要求的 LuaJIT 全记录比较、strict lint 和 git diff 空白检查吗？"});
